description: Ministry of Labour - Appointed Mr. K. A. T. Fernando as the arbitrator to the  Industrial Dispute between R. M. Somasiri with 17 others & S. L. Mahaweli Authority and Mr. S. Kariyawasam as the arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between U. M. C. L. Fernando & Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corp. Ltd. (Sri Lanka) (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of legal powers under the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains statutory orders made under specific legislative authority (Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions a Minister's name and title, it does not describe detailed portfolio responsibilities but rather shows the Minister exercising specific legal powers granted by legislation. The content focuses on regulatory procedures for dispute resolution rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
